title: Life Arcade
unlocks: home decorations, family badges and shared achievements

games.name: Chore Dash
games.how: Who could do this chore? Sort it to the right age group.
games.teaches: Sharing chores fairly, at the right age, takes the load off everyone.

games.name: Clean Sweep
games.how: Catch the mess for the basket. Dodge the things that should never go in it.
games.teaches: Tidy fast, and know what needs special disposal.

games.name: Battery Check
games.how: Would this recharge or drain someone's social battery?
games.teaches: Everyone recharges differently. Noticing helps you look after each other.

games.name: Memory Matters
games.how: Match each household thing to how often it needs renewing or doing.
games.teaches: The boring dates that cause big headaches when missed.

games.name: Family Bank
games.how: Kid-friendly money challenges. Virtual money only!
games.teaches: Saving, spending and waiting: money basics for the whole family.

games.name: Mood Matcher
games.how: Pick the kindest way to check in.
games.teaches: Small check-ins keep families and friends close.

games.name: Household Hustle
games.how: Put the jobs in the smartest order.
games.teaches: The right order saves time and effort.

games.name: Family Quest
games.how: Spin a team challenge for the whole household.
games.teaches: Working together makes chores feel lighter.
